The requirement specified that stopping a suspended [`StopWatch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_55_group_c_fix/src/java/org/apache/commons/lang/time/StopWatch.java) must preserve the elapsed time recorded when it was suspended.

### Root Cause
In [`StopWatch.stop()`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_55_group_c_fix/src/java/org/apache/commons/lang/time/StopWatch.java#L114-L121), `stopTime = System.currentTimeMillis()` was unconditionally executed even if the stopwatch was currently in the `STATE_SUSPENDED` state, overwriting the `stopTime` captured upon suspension.

### Fix
Updated [`StopWatch.stop()`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_55_group_c_fix/src/java/org/apache/commons/lang/time/StopWatch.java#L118-L120) to only assign `stopTime = System.currentTimeMillis()` if `this.runningState == STATE_RUNNING`. When stopping from a suspended state, the `stopTime` captured during `suspend()` is preserved.

The patch has been generated and saved to [negative_fix.patch](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_55_group_c_fix/negative_fix.patch). The Cucumber verification test passes completely.
